Message.Name: System State
Message.Description: This message format is used to notify firms of the state changes of the system. Firms can use notifications as triggers in their system to ensure electronic synchronization of systems.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by Emerald system.

Field.Name: CTD Version
Field.Description: E.g.: CTD1.0. Firm are advised to send the CTD Version number indicated on the cover page this document.

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID for the current trading session. A change in Session ID will mean that restarting at message sequence number 1.

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current system status

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Emerald trade-related content for entitled parties. Emerald sends trades, trade corrections and trade cancels using this message. This is a sequenced message.

Field.Name: Processing Time
Field.Description: Time at which Emerald system (Matching Engine) processed this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Time
Field.Description: Automatic Trades: Time at which the Matching Engine created this trade. Will be same as Processing Time. Manual Trades: Trade Time of the new manual trade. Trades cancels, corrections: Trade Time of the original trade.

Field.Name: Trade As-of Date
Field.Description: As-of Date for As-of Trades. Format: YYYYMMDD. Zero for non As-of Trades.

Field.Name: Trade Action
Field.Description: Note that New trades and Trade Cancel messages can also be generated due to a Clearing changing correction. See Correction Type field for details.

Field.Name: Trade Type
Field.Description: Trade Type

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Emerald- assigned unique Trade ID for the day. For corrections and cancels, this is the trade ID of the original trade. When used in conjunction with Correction Number, Side and Trade Action, this is a unique identifier for each clearing trade.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Emerald- assigned unique Execution ID. Each side of the Clearing trade will have a unique Execution ID.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. Used to identify version of the trade being corrected or canceled. Increments by 1 for each subsequent correction. While this is 0 for new trades, new trades resulting from corrections may have a non-zero number.

Field.Name: Transaction ID
Field.Description: All clearing trades generated from a single Engine transaction will have the same transaction ID

Field.Name: Reference Trade Time
Field.Description: Time of the parent trade (version of this trade that was active prior to this correction) in case of a correction or a new trade generated due to correction. 0 otherwise.

Field.Name: Reference Trade ID
Field.Description: Trade ID of the parent trade in case of a correction or a new trade generated due to correction. 0 otherwise.

Field.Name: Reference Correction Number
Field.Description: Correction Number of the parent trade in case of a correction or a new trade generated due to correction. 0 otherwise.

Field.Name: Correction Type
Field.Description: Gives more information to the user when this is a correction.

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: Event ID in case this trade is a result of a liquidity gathering event at Emerald. 0 otherwise. Please refer to the TransactionType field for the Event type associated with this Event ID.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Emerald- assigned unique Complex Strategy ID for the day. Populated only for complex trades, otherwise set to zero.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Option leg: Emerald Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for the option or stock leg. Format for Stock Leg: OCC Options Underlying Symbol (default) or Stock Ticker Symbol (configurable)

Field.Name: Underlying Type
Field.Description: Underlying Type

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option leg: Option Security Symbol. Stock leg: Filled with spaces = N/A (Not Applicable)

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Option leg: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Option leg: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option leg: Option Type

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the trade on which this receiver was involved in.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price. In case of a corrected trade, this is the corrected trade price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of option contracts or stock shares traded in this clearing trade. In case of a corrected trade, this is the corrected trade size.

Field.Name: Trade condition
Field.Description: See Appendix A: Trade Conditions for list of possible values. CTD Version 1.0 will always have a Regular trade condition (= ‘ ‘ / space) for all system generated automatic trades. In case of a corrected trade, this is the corrected trade condition.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Class Fee Type
Field.Description: Class Fee Type

Field.Name: Emerald BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: Option leg: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by Emerald

Field.Name: Execution Exchange
Field.Description: Option leg: Market where a customer option order was traded after routing from Emerald

Field.Name: Routed Order Quantity
Field.Description: This contains 0 (zero) for trades at Emerald. For trades resulting from Orders routed to other exchanges, this contains total routed quantity that will be useful in calculating away-exchange block size billing rate.

Field.Name: Market Maker Role
Field.Description: Pertains to this side.

Field.Name: Traded with Directed MM
Field.Description: Indicates if the trade occurred with the MM to which the order was Directed

Field.Name: Market State
Field.Description: Simple Market State

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Simple Market Auction Type. Only applicable when Market State is Auction.

Field.Name: Directed Status
Field.Description: Status of directed order flow.

Field.Name: Strategy State
Field.Description: Strategy State

Field.Name: Strategy Auction Type
Field.Description: Only applicable when Strategy State is Standard Auction.

Field.Name: Stock Execution Destination
Field.Description: Stock leg: Stock trading/reporting venue that will report and clear the stock leg trade.

Field.Name: Contra Liquidity Type
Field.Description: Contra Liquidity Type

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Executing MPID
Field.Description: For Trades due to Orders: MPID of the EEM/OFP (SenderSubID field in FIX order or FirmMPID for Emerald PRIME/cPRIME Order; Note that this will be different than Clearing MPID for MM FIX orders). For Trades due to Quotes, eQuotes: MM MPID.

Field.Name: Order Date
Field.Description: For Trades due to Orders: Format: YYYYMMDD. For Trades due to Quotes, eQuotes: zero.

Field.Name: FIX Order ID
Field.Description: For Trades due to Orders: Firm assigned Order ID sent via the CLOrderID FIX field. For Trades due to Quotes, eQuotes: Spaces.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: For Trades due to Quotes, eQuotes: Firm assigned ID of the Quote or eQuote. For Trades due to Orders: zero.

Field.Name: Bulk Quote Index
Field.Description: For Trades due to Quotes: Index assigned by Emerald to each quote in bulk quote (Index = quote position in the bulk quote). For Trades due to Orders, eQuotes: zero.

Field.Name: Open/Close Indicator
Field.Description: Option leg: Open/Close Indicator

Field.Name: Liquidity Type
Field.Description: Pertains to this side.

Field.Name: MM Priority Indicator
Field.Description: Pertains to this side only if this side belongs to a market maker.

Field.Name: Liquidity Indicator
Field.Description: Pertains to this side.

Field.Name: Liquidity Timer Role
Field.Description: When the liquidity is involved in a trade occurring in a Emerald PRIME Auction or Timer Event, this field contains the role of the liquidity.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: TimeInForce

Field.Name: BillingMPID
Field.Description: For Trades due to Orders: specifies the MPID that is being Billed. This defaults to the same as the Executing MPID unless an alternative MPID is specified on order entry. For Trades due to Quotes, eQuotes: MM MPID.

Field.Name: Leg Reference ID
Field.Description: Client specified ID in FIX complex order for the leg corresponding to the option in this trade.

Field.Name: Strategy Timer Role
Field.Description: When the liquidity is involved in a trade occurring in a Complex Standard Auction as defined in field Strategy Auction Type, or a cPRIME auction or cC2C or cQCC crossing, this field contains the role of the liquidity.

Field.Name: Stock Short Sell indicator
Field.Description: Stock Short Sell indicator

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Clearing MPID
Field.Description: Option leg: Clearing MPID of the member. Stock leg: Underlying MPID or the DTC Account number

Field.Name: Member Type
Field.Description: Member Type

Field.Name: Origin
Field.Description: Origin

Field.Name: Clearing Number
Field.Description: Option leg: OCC Clearing number. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: Option leg: CMTA in case of a give-up trade. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Description: Sub or multi account ID specified in FIX order

Field.Description: Account ID that is supplied in the FIX order

Field.Description: Supplementary ID supplied in the Text field of the FIX order

Field.Name: Allocation ID
Field.Description: Individual Allocation ID (Tag 467) for each Emerald PRIME/cPRIME Order participant supplied in the FIX New Order Cross. If not applicable, filled with spaces.

Field.Description: OCC Clearing number to be billed. This defaults to the same as the Clearing Number unless an alternative Billing MPID is specified on order entry. For Trades due to Quotes, eQuotes: MM Clearing Number.

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Order Capacity

Message.Name: Risk Notification Message
Message.Description: Firms configured to use Risk Protection Monitoring will receive User Notification communicating the status of Risk checks. Field Event Type is used to determine the reason for the notification. The following message will be used to disseminate all Emerald Risk Protection Monitor (RPM) related notifications. Sequenced and UnSequenced Pkt based on Event Type: solicited event types (T, R, W, D, A, P, U) are Sequenced messages at the SesM protocol level and recoverable; unsolicited (S) are Unsequenced and not recoverable.

Field.Name: Processing Time
Field.Description: Time at which Emerald system (Matching Engine) processed this notification.

Field.Name: MPID Group ID
Field.Description: Firm Assigned Group ID

Field.Name: Metric ID
Field.Description: Metric ID for the group

Field.Name: Route ID
Field.Description: ID used to route to this session.

Field.Name: Metric Type
Field.Description: Metric Type

Field.Name: Protection Type
Field.Description: Protection Type

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Event Type

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by Emerald for this event. Can be used to order events. Event Type S Event ID will equal zero

Field.Name: Configured Counting Time Period
Field.Description: Configured time period in milliseconds which is used to consider events for this Metric ID

Field.Name: Configured Max Quantity
Field.Description: Configured max threshold of counted items for the Configured Counting Time interval for this Metric ID. Defines rate for the counting time period.

Field.Name: Current Quantity
Field.Description: Current counted quantity at the time of the event for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: Max Peak Quantity
Field.Description: Max peak for Current Quantity during pulse interval

Field.Name: Percentage Level
Field.Description: Current Percentage for the Counted Quantity in relationship to Configured Max Quantity. Valid values from 0 to 255%. Actual percentages greater than 255 will be reported as the max (255)

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.
